buildFromFolder.title: Build a dataset from a folder of notes
buildFromFolder.intro: Your notes are read, scrubbed of secrets and names, cut into passages, and the local model writes questions and answers from each passage. Training on them teaches a small model how your notes talk: their words, decisions and the kind of answer you expect. It does not reliably recall exact facts, dates or numbers; searching your files does that, so adding the folder to Files is on.
buildFromFolder.folderPlaceholder: Choose a folder on the Guaardvark machine
buildFromFolder.alsoIndex: Also add to Files and index it for search
buildFromFolder.alsoIndexTooltip: Copies the whole folder into Files as it is (your originals stay where they are) and indexes it, so chat can answer from the notes themselves. The copy does not skip what the training build leaves out (files named like keys or passwords, copied packages, very large files) and is not scrubbed; only the training data is.

trainingLibraries.baseModelsIntro: The models a fine-tune starts from. Download fetches one from huggingface.co when you click it, without your Hugging Face token; training itself never downloads.
trainingLibraries.notMeasured: Not offered for training yet: its GPU memory has not been measured.
trainingLibraries.converterIntro: Export to Ollama converts a trained model to one GGUF file with llama.cpp's converter (MIT license). Nothing downloads until you click Install; then the converter's files come from GitHub at a pinned release, each checked against the sha256 Guaardvark pins. No Python packages are installed: it runs on the ones Guaardvark already has.
trainingLibraries.converterUnusable: The installed converter cannot be used: {{problem}}. Install it again.
trainingLibraries.removeLibrariesDescription: Uninstalls them from Guaardvark's Python environment. Training jobs refuse to start until they are installed again.
trainingLibraries.keepsTrained: trained adapters, exported models and training datasets
trainingLibraries.removeModelDescription: Deletes its weights from this machine. Jobs on it refuse to start until it is downloaded again.
trainingLibraries.installConverterDescription: Downloads llama.cpp's Hugging Face to GGUF converter, MIT-licensed code by the ggml authors. Each file is checked against the sha256 Guaardvark pins before it is kept; if any differs, nothing is installed. Remove deletes it again.
trainingLibraries.removeConverterDescription: Deletes it from this machine. Export to Ollama waits until it is installed again.
trainingLibraries.keepsConverter: trained adapters, exported GGUF files and the models already in Ollama
